mostWorthwhile.text: Putting the sleeve around the capped bones made the joint's design clear: cartilage and fluid help the hard bones move past each other.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add bone cells directly to the reinforced fibres was frustrating because the picture suggested they belonged together, but the game gave no reason the pairing was unavailable.

surprise.text: Inspecting the bone cells automatically paired them with blood vessels, and the picture showed nutrients reaching the cells through tiny channels.

arbitrary.text: The requirement to give the bone cells a blood supply before combining them with the fibres felt somewhat arbitrary. The blood supply's purpose became clear, but the required order wasn't clear beforehand.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: assembling the elbow and seeing how its parts support movement was interesting, even though the bone-building order was confusing.
